answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake as its anchor before it can transact or vote. The stake stays bonded for the whole voyage of the account and is slashed if peer graders prove fraud. Creating one honest identity is cheap, but spinning up ten thousand fakes multiplies the locked capital, and each fake risks losing its full bond on detection, so a Sybil swarm costs more than any terrace of honest earnings it could extract.
